messages:
Priya N.: Quick QBR checkpoint — I'm drafting a 'customer odometer' slide that summarizes onboarding status, health signals, and renewal risk. Need slide ownership and 1-2 risk bullets from each of you. Link to draft: https://drive.redwood.ai/odometer-draft (edit access).

Ethan K.: I can own the onboarding status + migration risks. Will add current seat counts and the migration timeline.

Jordan L.: I'll take the exec ask slide and the infra footprint note. Suggest we trim slides to 6 total: odometer, onboarding, health signals, exec asks, actions, appendix.

Maya R.: Heads up — from the customer side we have two visible signals: usage dip (~15% week-over-week) and repeated latency complaints on the dedicated endpoint. Adding notes to the draft.

Priya N.: Helpful, thanks. Two quick asks: (1) please post a single-line exec ask by EOD so I can convert to speaker note; (2) add onboarding blockers as a separate "risk" row in the odometer table.

Ethan K.: Adding now. Blocker: SSO cert rotation failed for staging app. Needs apps-team cert update. Assigned to @Jordan L. ETA: next Tue.

Jordan L.: Ack — I'll ping infra and Apps. Also proposed wording for exec ask: "Approve 2-week dedicated infra slot + burst capacity to stabilize demo environment and remediate SSO certs." Thoughts?

Priya N.: Love that wording — concise and action-oriented. @CS Ops Bot can you attach the latest PPT export here?

CS Ops Bot: Attached: odometer_v1.pptx (https://files.redwood.ai/odometer_v1.pptx) :white_check_mark:

Maya R.: I'll capture a short customer quote for the opening (1 sentence). Will drop it by 4pm.

Priya N.: Also: can we do a 15-min dry run tomorrow 10:30am PDT? Prefer to lock slides after the run.

Ethan K.: I'm in for 10:30.

Jordan L.: Can do. I'll prepare the infra slide notes.

Maya R.: I'll join for first 10 mins then handoff.

Priya N.: Perfect. I'll update the action tracker. Current action items (adding here so nothing drops):

```
- Priya N. — finalize odometer layout + speaker notes (due: today 6pm)
- Ethan K. — onboarding status + migration timeline + SSO blocker details (due: today 5pm)
- Jordan L. — contact Apps/Infra re: cert rotation and confirm ETA; prepare exec ask wording (due: tomorrow 9am)
- Maya R. — customer quote for opening slide (due: today 4pm)
- All — attend 10:30am PDT dry run (tomorrow)
```

Jordan L.: I'll also add a single fallback statement in case infra can't commit — a two-week canary extension option.

Priya N.: Good idea. If anyone adds big changes, drop a quick comment here so I know to re-export. Thanks all :bow: 

Ethan K.: noted — will comment when done.

CS Ops Bot: Export queued: odometer_v1.1.pptx (will post when ready).

Maya R.: Thanks — will review after I drop the quote.

Priya N.: Closing loop — plan: finish slides today, dry run tomorrow, final deck to exec after dry run. If anything blocks, escalate here.

Ethan K.: +1

Jordan L.: +1

Maya R.: +1
